_note: Hand check of loinc:interpreted_in_finding (LOINC result term -> the SNOMED CT finding whose definition interprets that result). An edge is CORRECT when the LOINC term measures what the finding's Interprets target measures -- same analyte, same or narrower specimen -- so the finding's Has interpretation value (above / below / within range, detected ...) applied to a result of that term is the observation SNOMED uses to define the finding. It does NOT claim the result diagnoses the finding: DKA is defined partly by a raised glucose, not diagnosed by one. Graded 23 Sep 2026 on the rules as built. Two samples, drawn after the rules were fixed: 40 edges at random, and one random edge from each of 40 random findings (the first is dominated by glucose x diabetes findings; the second is not). graph_report.py earns a tier for each route (the row's `method`, which is the edge's `method`) from this file.

history.failures: LOINC specimen broader than the finding's ('Glucose in Specimen' -> ketoacidosis; 'Microalbumin in Body fluid' -> microalbuminuria); ratio and difference properties (Calcium/Albumin ratio; glucose concentration difference); refined targets -- Random blood glucose measurement for a timed or fasting LOINC term, Urine protein electrophoresis for a plain urine protein term; one Fluctuation of blood glucose
not graded edge by edge -- plainly unusable (erythrocytes in prostatic fluid -> haemolytic anaemia); the specimen is required

history.sample: after rules 1-3, one edge per finding (tuning sample, not counted)
history.failures: 'Other cells' and 'Protein.abnormal band' (the LOINC Extension's Component drops the refinement); a urea nitrogen mass ratio -> rule 4 and 5 added

history.sample: Athena-direct, unrestricted (not counted; rows in history_scored)
history.failures: edges shared with the analyte bridge 26/27; edges only Athena makes 27/53 -- Athena's procedures are often specimen-less, so sodium in breast milk, pleural-fluid pH and urine red cells reached serum and blood findings; ratios; HEDIS value-set and deprecated codes. Restricted to the LOINC Ontology's specimen, result codes and the ratio rules.

history.sample: narrower-analyte rule by is-a (tested, not adopted)
history.failures: SNOMED files 'Sodium electrolyte' under 'Sodium' (126 correct edges would go) and does not file 'Free testosterone' under 'Testosterone' -- so fractions are a reviewed list of component codes instead

rules: same Component (246093002) on the LOINC observable and on the finding's Interprets target
the LOINC Direct site (704327008) equals the target's Has specimen (116686009) or is below it (is-a)
the target is the most general procedure for its component and specimen (no is-a ancestor carries both), which drops random / fasting / electrophoresis refinements
no 'Relative to' (704325000) on the LOINC observable, and no LOINC PROPERTY of kind ratio or difference
LOINC COMPONENT heads the extension models lossily are excluded: Protein.abnormal band, Other cells, Unidentified cells, Cells counted.total
the interpretation is the finding's Has interpretation (363713009) in the same role group as the Interprets

rules_athena: the LOINC term's Athena procedure is itself the finding's Interprets target (no is-a climbing)
LOINC term in the LOINC Ontology's Observation refset, ACTIVE in LOINC 2.83, not Discouraged
the analyte bridge's ratio / difference / lossy-component rules

specimen: the LOINC Direct site is at or below one of the target's Has specimen values; where the target states no specimen, the LOINC Direct site is at or below Blood specimen (119297000) -- an assumption this route supplies, scored on its own

fraction analytes (free and bioavailable testosterone, unconjugated estriol, bilirubin-albumin complex, indirect bilirubin, anion gap, HDL sub-fraction III, small LDL) are excluded where the LOINC component differs from the target's
